oracle_scope: minimum count in the same realized union of two fixed-tree pruning families and the estimated-order contiguous family
oracle_threshold_comparison: python-flint Arb enclosure refined until every exact rational cell distortion is certified on one side of c exp(-delta); a rational separator preserving that certified feasible set is then passed to the unchanged exact selector

sidak.propensity_individual_error: largest m/2^80 whose exact product (1-m/2^80)^K is at least 1-alpha_e
sidak.selection: unchanged realized candidate families, caps and exact tie rules

pooled_contiguous_screen.datasets: replication 10 in every one of the 48 historical conditions
pooled_contiguous_screen.candidate_collection: conditional on the independent pilot: every distinct nonsingleton cell in the two fixed trees or the pilot-order contiguous family

heldout_allocation.pooled: alpha/5 divided by the complete conditional cell collection

pooled_contiguous_screen.decision_rule: bounded all-condition screen only; do not expand unless the matched pooling increment is practically material and the full-data gap is plausibly recovered

reporting.historical_weighting: equal weight over 48 fixed conditions; uncertainty over 100 paired replication-index condition averages
reporting.condition_binary: pointwise two-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson with the actual independent dataset denominator
reporting.paired: paired differences over independent blocks; binary differences use mean-SE, not a pooled binomial interval

scope: retrospective assignment-only investigation over fresh public assignment artifacts; population truth is used only for oracle calculations and diagnostics; no manuscript or historical result is modified
